sourceCaveat: The original book edition has not been independently checked. See the listed source and full record for attribution limits.

reference.criterion: Ordinary people without instrumental training can construct music with software.
reference.rationale: GarageBand’s 2004 loop/instrument tools were explicitly designed to make music creation accessible without conventional musicianship. The functional prediction was met; brain-wave control in the passage is an example, not a condition imposed on all composition.
